rows.source_authority: Federal Bureau of Investigation Vault; memorandum to Atomic Energy Commission
rows.reported_summary: A radio-station operator reported a radar object directly over Oak Ridge on March 1, 1950. The federal memorandum records that qualified persons examined the equipment and considered it not very reliable; the operator's radar theory and reliability were questioned.
